desc: Analyze problem structure: derive bottom-up DP where each subtree returns 0 (fully decomposed) or one open chain length ℓ∈[1,K-1]; prove per-node resolution is forced (|S|≤2, pair must sum to K-1, single chain extends, empty starts fresh); K=1 trivially Yes.
Validate DP on samples and hand-built cases (stars, paths, branching Yes/No examples); confirm deterministic correctness via structural induction.
Implement solve() in Python with iterative post-order (no recursion), fast I/O, O(V) time; handle K=1 special case and root-return-0 acceptance.

Build a brute-force verifier (enumerate path partitions for tiny V) and stress-test against the DP on random trees (paths, stars, caterpillars, random recursive trees), both Yes and No instances — exhaustive V≤7 and 3000+ random cases all agree; planted Yes-instances 100% accepted; root-independence verified.
Finalize: confirm sample outputs (Yes / No), edge cases (K=1, N=1, K=V, deep chain recursion safety), clean stdin/stdout code with exact "Yes"/"No" output.
